title: LLM Router
description: Operator view of router readiness, traffic, latency, capacity, costs, batch, GPU and pod health without request content.

panels.title: Overview
panels.description: Current readiness and build identity; snapshots can lag by the health cache interval.

panels.title: Router ready
panels.description: Cached readiness is 1 when all required checks pass; a stale snapshot can delay a transition.

panels.title: Classifier qualified
panels.description: Qualified classifier backend count; empty until qualification probes complete.

panels.title: Deployments ready
panels.description: Ready deployments under selection; health is sampled.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: Committed terminal requests per second; admission rejections are separate.

panels.title: Error %
panels.description: Terminal errors divided by all terminal requests; no traffic yields no value.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Interactive and batch requests currently running; excludes queued work.

panels.title: p95 TTFT
panels.description: Time to first token among observed output; non-stream requests may lack TTFT.

panels.title: Decode tok / s
panels.description: p50 per-response decode throughput; missing completion usage yields no observation.

panels.title: Build version / commit
panels.description: Running version and source commit; gauge value 1 only marks build identity.

panels.title: Persistence ready
panels.description: SQLite readiness from cached health; 0 indicates persistence cannot serve traffic.

panels.title: Health age
panels.description: Seconds since the latest health snapshot; older snapshots can hide a new outage.

panels.title: Keys by state
panels.description: Durable active, revoked and expired key counts; not traffic volume.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Routed request events and admission outcomes; event counts are not necessarily unique requests.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Committed terminal request rate by status; counters exclude uncommitted attempts.

panels.title: Errors by tag
panels.description: Terminal failures by bounded internal tag; none is excluded.

panels.title: Admissions
panels.description: Admission outcomes include rejections before routing.

panels.title: Route decisions
panels.description: Bounded decision reasons and locations; one request can cause several decisions.

panels.title: Route exclusions
panels.description: Exclusion codes describe candidate elimination, not unique rejected requests.

panels.title: Local overload
panels.description: Report and failover events are not unique terminal requests.

panels.title: Streams by outcome
panels.description: Stream terminal outcomes exclude non-stream calls.

panels.title: Requests by location / priority
panels.description: Committed terminal request rate; unrouted requests can lack a location.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Observed latency distributions; low-traffic quantiles can be noisy or absent.

panels.title: Request p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Terminal duration includes routing and generation; quantiles are not additive.

panels.title: TTFT p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: First-token latency applies only to observed streamed output.

panels.title: Generation p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Generation duration excludes queue and prefill; absent until measured.

panels.title: Queue wait p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Wait is measured when queued work exits; timeout events appear separately.

panels.title: Classifier p95 latency
panels.description: Backend p95 classification time; empty until classification occurs.

panels.title: Queue p95 by priority
panels.description: Priority-specific wait highlights contention; empty with no queued work.

panels.title: Throughput & tokens
panels.description: Usage-derived token and cache metrics; unknown upstream usage is never zero.

panels.title: Token throughput by kind
panels.description: Observed prompt, completion, reasoning and cached token rates; missing usage is not zero.

panels.title: Token throughput by key
panels.description: Token rate joins active key names; revoked or expired keys do not appear.

panels.title: Decode throughput distribution
panels.description: Per-response decode rates show a distribution, not aggregate tokens per second.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits divided by observed hits and misses; unknown observations are excluded.

panels.title: Unknown usage fields
panels.description: Missing upstream usage by field; never interpret absent usage as zero tokens.

panels.title: Capacity
panels.description: Current permits and bounded queue events; live gauges change between scrapes.

panels.title: Permits in use / max
panels.description: In-use permits versus maximum capacity; max is once per deployment.

panels.title: Permits by priority
panels.description: Currently held permits per deployment and priority; excludes queued work.

panels.title: Reserved interactive
panels.description: Permits protected for interactive work; reservation is not utilization.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Live waiting queue depth; may change between scrapes.

panels.title: Queue events
panels.description: Queued, dispatched, timeout and full events; several events may occur per request.

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: Accounting in USD by mutually exclusive interpretation; kinds must never be added together.

panels.title: USD / s by cost kind
panels.description: Provider-reported, estimated, local-compute and cache-savings kinds are NOT additive.

panels.title: USD by key and kind
panels.description: Active-key names joined to cost; kinds represent alternative views and MUST NOT be summed.

panels.title: Keys
panels.description: Active key limits and requests; revoked or expired keys are absent from the name join.

panels.title: Active key limits and live rate
panels.description: Active keys show RPM and concurrency limits; a missing rate means no observations, not zero.

panels.title: Batch
panels.description: Durable batch states and dispatch events; events may outnumber unique items.

panels.title: Jobs by status
panels.description: Durable batch job states from SQLite; snapshots can lag dispatch events.

panels.title: Items by status
panels.description: Durable batch item states; counts are not throughput.

panels.title: Remote intents by state
panels.description: Persisted remote intents; reconciled states can outlive active jobs.

panels.title: Dispatch outcomes
panels.description: Local and remote batch dispatch events; retry attempts can repeat.

panels.title: Classifier
panels.description: Classifier activity by bounded category; qualification gates may delay observations.

panels.title: Classifications by source / reuse
panels.description: Event rate by backend, source and reuse; cache reuse differs from fresh classification.

panels.title: Classifications by task / difficulty
panels.description: Task and difficulty are bounded categories; empty until classification occurs.

panels.title: Classifier input tokens
panels.description: Classifier input token rate by backend; unavailable usage is omitted.

panels.title: Backend ready / qualified
panels.description: Readiness and qualification are separate cached gates; qualification may lag readiness.

panels.title: Strix Halo GPU correlation
panels.description: pve4 host hardware and router request rate share time but do not prove causality.

panels.title: GPU edge temp / router traffic
panels.description: pve4 Radeon edge temperature overlaid with terminal request rate; axes have different units.

panels.title: GPU PPT / router traffic
panels.description: pve4 Radeon PPT power overlaid with request rate; axes have different units.

panels.title: pve4 CPU usage
panels.description: Host-wide CPU busy percentage via node-exporter; overlaid router rate uses the right axis and does not isolate router CPU.

panels.title: pve4 memory used
panels.description: Host memory used excludes available memory; overlaid router rate uses the right axis and router pod memory is separate.

panels.title: Pod
panels.description: Kubernetes container and probe signals; missing scrapes are distinct from zero.

panels.title: Router container memory
panels.description: Working-set bytes for the app container; excludes pod sandbox and host memory.

panels.title: Router container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores for the app container; cAdvisor rate needs two scrape samples.

panels.title: Pod restarts
panels.description: Kube-state restart counter by pod/container; resets on pod recreation.

panels.title: External app probe
panels.description: Blackbox probe success 1/0 for probe/llm-router/app; absent scrape differs from failure.

panels.title: Process
panels.description: Per-process memory and timing; restart resets in-memory series.

panels.title: RSS / heap
panels.description: Resident and heap-used bytes show process memory; RSS includes native allocations.

panels.title: Event loop p99
panels.description: p99 event-loop delay in seconds; GC and scrape scheduling affect observations.

panels.title: Metrics scrape duration
panels.description: Time spent formatting the previous metrics scrape, not this one.

panels.title: Process start time
panels.description: Unix start timestamp; restarts reset in-memory metrics.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Loki namespace logs are operational text and can contain sensitive data.

panels.title: Router pod logs
panels.description: Loki namespace logs can contain sensitive content; Grafana access must stay restricted.

panels.title: Provider cache locality
panels.description: OpenRouter provider verification, observed cache usage and reported savings.

panels.title: Cached prompt token ratio
panels.description: Cached tokens / prompt tokens on requests with known cache usage, by deployment. Unknown cache usage is excluded; known zero hits plot 0%.

panels.title: Cache observations by deployment
panels.description: Observed hit, miss and unknown requests per second; counts are not weighted by cached tokens.

panels.title: Provider pin matches
panels.description: Completed OpenRouter responses whose serving provider matches the deployment restriction in the selected time range.

panels.title: Provider pin mismatches
panels.description: Must be zero; a positive value means OpenRouter served a different provider despite the pin. No completions yields no value.

panels.title: Provider-reported cache savings
panels.description: No cloud savings USD series is emitted: OpenRouter cache_discount has no explicit USD unit. Empty until a sourced provider USD amount exists; never infer from rates.
